title: Smart Data Models - DigitalAssetMetric
description: A digital marketing observation of a DigitalAsset for a specific date and temporal granularity (daily/monthly/quarterly/yearly). Includes traffic, engagement, e-commerce, organic-social and paid-ads metrics. Metrics that admit segmentation by acquisition channel group are arrays of {channelGroup, value}; the rest are scalars. Non-applicable metrics are omitted (sparse schema).

channelGroup.description: Name of the acquisition channel group (e.g. Direct, Organic Search, Paid Search, Organic Social, Paid Social, Referral, Email, Cross-network, Unassigned). Comes from the source platform - GA4 reports it natively as defaultChannelGroup; for other platforms the producer is responsible for mapping.

value.description: Numeric value of the metric for this segment.

SegmentedMetricValue.description: Array of {channelGroup, value} pairs describing the breakdown of the parent metric by acquisition channel group.

id.description: Unique identifier. Recommended pattern: urn:ngsi-ld:DigitalAssetMetric:<Brand>:<Software>:<temporalResolution>. NOT including the date: the broker performs upsert on the same id, Quantum Leap (or any subscriber) keeps the history indexed by dateObserved.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DigitalAssetMetric.

dateObserved.description: Property. Reference timestamp of the observation (ISO 8601). Combined with `temporalResolution` defines the time window. For daily granularity (P1D) it is the start-of-day in UTC of the observed day.

temporalResolution.description: Property. ISO 8601 duration. Granularity of the observation: daily (P1D), monthly (P1M), quarterly (P3M), yearly (P1Y). Each granularity is published as an independent entity to avoid the non-additivity problem of unique-user metrics.

refDigitalAsset.description: Relationship. URN of the DigitalAsset observed.

refDataProvider.description: Relationship. URN of the DataProvider that supplied this observation. Required for traceability and to disambiguate parallel feeds for the same (channel, day, granularity).

keyEventsPurchase.description: Property. Key events 'purchase' broken down by channel group.

keyEventsGenerateLead.description: Property. Key events 'generate_lead' broken down by channel group.

purchaseRevenue.description: Property. Revenue from purchases broken down by channel group. Monetary; emit with NGSI-LD meta `unitCode` (ISO 4217, default EUR).

sessions.description: Property. Sessions broken down by channel group.

totalRevenue.description: Property. Total revenue broken down by channel group. Monetary; emit with `unitCode` (default EUR).

channelCount.description: Property. Number of distinct acquisition channels active in the period.

campaignCount.description: Property. Number of distinct campaigns active in the period.

engagedSessions.description: Property. Sessions classified as engaged by the source platform.

userEngagementDuration.description: Property. Aggregated user engagement time. Emit with `unitCode` = C26 (minutes, UN/CEFACT).

pageViews.description: Property. Page (or screen) views aggregated in the period.

keyEvents.description: Property. Total key events (sum of all conversion-like events).

totalUsers.description: Property. Total users (unique users in the period at this granularity).

totalPurchasers.description: Property. Distinct purchasers in the period.

itemRefundAmount.description: Property. Total amount refunded. Monetary; emit with `unitCode` (default EUR).

organicKeywordCount.description: Property. SEO. Number of distinct organic keywords driving impressions.

organicAveragePosition.description: Property. SEO. Average ranking position across organic keywords. Dimensionless.

organicFollowers.description: Property. Social. Total followers at end of period.

organicFollowersGained.description: Property. Social. Followers gained during the period.

organicFollowersLost.description: Property. Social. Followers lost during the period.

organicImpressions.description: Property. Organic impressions or content views (posts, reels, stories...).

organicLikes.description: Property. Social. Likes on organic content.

organicDislikes.description: Property. Social. Dislikes on organic content (e.g. YouTube).

organicReactions.description: Property. Social. Total reactions on organic content.

organicComments.description: Property. Social. Comments on organic content.

organicSaved.description: Property. Social. Times the content was saved/bookmarked.

organicShares.description: Property. Social. Shares of organic content.

organicVideosAddedToPlaylists.description: Property. Video. Times videos were added to playlists.

organicVideosRemovedFromPlaylists.description: Property. Video. Times videos were removed from playlists.

organicVideoViews.description: Property. Video. Video views from organic distribution.

organicInteractions.description: Property. Social. Total interactions = reactions + comments + shares + saved...

organicReach.description: Property. Social. Distinct people reached organically.

organicEngagementTime.description: Property. Social. Engagement time on organic content. Emit with `unitCode` = C26 (minutes).

organicVideoViewTime.description: Property. Video. Aggregated video viewing time. Emit with `unitCode` = C26 (minutes).

adsSpend.description: Property. Paid. Ads spend. Monetary; emit with `unitCode` (default EUR).

adsReach.description: Property. Paid. Distinct people reached by ads.

adsLikes.description: Property. Paid. Likes attributed to paid placements.

adsComments.description: Property. Paid. Comments attributed to paid placements.

adsShares.description: Property. Paid. Shares attributed to paid placements.

adsVideoViews.description: Property. Paid. Video views from paid placements.

adsInteractions.description: Property. Paid. Total interactions on paid placements.

adsEngagements.description: Property. Paid. Engagements = interactions + extras (clicks, expansions...).

adsConversions.description: Property. Paid. Conversions attributed to ads.

adsRevenue.description: Property. Paid. Revenue attributed to ads. Monetary; emit with `unitCode` (default EUR).

adsFollows.description: Property. Paid. New follows attributed to paid placements.

adsConversionsValue.description: Property. Paid. Total monetary value attributed to ad conversions. Emit with `unitCode` (default EUR).

adsReactions.description: Property. Paid. Total reactions (sentiment emojis: Like, Love, Haha, Wow, Sad, Angry) on a paid post.

organicContentPublications.description: Property. Organic. Total count of content pieces published organically in the period.
